name: bld4_pisano_mul_of_coprime
statement: (m n : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n) : p3_pisano (m * n) = Nat.lcm (p3_pisano m) (p3_pisano n)
closed: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n), p3_pisano (m * n) = Nat.lcm (p3_pisano m) (p3_pisano n)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_pos_and_period and Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period: pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd (m ∣ mn, n ∣ mn) gives lcm ∣ π(mn). Conversely pos_and_period makes L = lcm(π m, π n) a period mod m and mod n (iterate the period), hence mod mn by Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul for coprime m n, and dvd_of_period gives π(mn) ∣ L. Case m = 0 forces n = 1 (both sides 0).
type: ∀ (m n : ℕ), m.Coprime n → Mathlib2.p3_pisano (m * n) = (Mathlib2.p3_pisano m).lcm (Mathlib2.p3_pisano n)
